* '''PC-E1''' ([[Orbital Bombardment (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 25 release sheet<ref name="sheet25-20250810">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (PDF, 10 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, August 2025”; file created 10 August 2025). The printed footer identifies the August 2025 edition; the PDF creation date is file metadata.</ref>, page 4, file created 10 August 2025: “During battle at a site related to a system your dreadnaught or Star Destroyer occupies, add 1 to your total battle destiny. If you also control that system (or occupy it with Fulminatrix), add 2 instead and the number of battle destiny draws may not be limited.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Orbital Bombardment]] (Original). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[Orbital Bombardment]] (repository revision 7 August 2025) as a printable slip under the label “•Orbital Bombardment”; the printed face matches the image in artwork, wording and visible printed details; the sheet omits the top padding and uses different image encoding. A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
